name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.25.0: opt-in, default-off additions. Claude Code 2.1.295 or later is recommended (async SessionStart resume fix) and vault_doctor.py --host-version checks the PATH claude only on request; warning-only healthcheck checks flag sync-client conflict or temporary file names and engine notes changed after the last checkpoint; recall evaluation can run a hand-labelled gold set in place with redaction, a dev/held-out split and inspected marks, plus exact paired p-values and rate upper bounds; tool-call runs can record llama-server prompt-cache, slot and repeat-agreement conditions. The advisory CI audit installs pip-audit from hash-pinned wheels. Existing memory, diagnostics, budgets and the Jarvis API-auth boundary remain. No default network/model call or automatic vault migration.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
